summary: Georgia tower list places camp four in Clinch County with elevation 195 (unit unstated); no other source found on its history or the site today.

evidence.supports: List row for camp four: coordinates, Clinch County, elevation column 195
List says names for towers numbered 73 and above are the compiler's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: The list's Google map is marked as revised on 22 March 2016

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list supports this record. Two WebSearch queries (Georgia Forestry Commission and Clinch County or Homerville fire tower) found no source on this tower. The Eastern U.S. Lookouts directory has no camp-four page (camp-four.html returns 404). The Homerville CCC camp that search returned is a different site and is not used. The list gives its elevation with no unit; the brief's elevation_m of 59.4 assumes feet and is not carried into the story. The story is about 90 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because no second source exists in the cache or search. Nothing found describes the site today or public access. No photos.
